scope: Complete sparse-terminal lemma H(character*(1-2*1_E))<=6I for |E|<=4, PROOF section2, including dense regime and edge-isoperimetric induction.
excluded: Odd-face surgery ledgers, fair-selector access/activation theorem and other inherited claims are not independently accepted by this review.
reconstruction: Own PROOF section4 supplies full entropy/edge proof, and extends it to six edits. critical.py independently checks three-bit seed internal-edge and minimum-boundary inequalities with direct character sums; this is not a replay of A022 code.
finite_scope: 128 normalized arbitrary three-bit Boolean seeds; not a census of all-dimensional sparse leaves.
